_note: Central switches for the player and web-game page. Edit by hand or (next release) from the admin panel. Every key is optional: a missing or invalid value falls back to the default shown here.

controls._touchDefault: auto = open on phones, closed on desktop. Other values: on, off, tap

webGames._preload: ask = show the choice before the first Play. always = load in the background without asking. never = old behaviour (load when Play is pressed)
